Run the Monitor Every Day

Source: R/schedule_monitor.R
schedule_monitor.Rd

Write an R script that runs the whole monitor on a folder of station exports, and schedule it to run every day:

  • on Windows it is registered in the Task Scheduler with the taskscheduleR package;

  • on Linux and macOS the line to add to the crontab (crontab -e) is printed.

Every run reads all exports in folder (read_station()), runs run_monitor(), and writes write_monitor_report() and write_monitor_tables() into out_dir/<last day>/.

schedule_monitor(
  folder,
  out_dir,
  time = "07:30",
  taskname = "tidypptsdm_monitor",
  script_dir = out_dir,
  format = c("xlsx", "csv"),
  register = TRUE,
  ...,
  verbose = 1
)

Arguments

folder

Folder with the station exports.

out_dir

Folder for the results; one subfolder per day.

time

Time of the daily run, "HH:MM". Default "07:30".

taskname

Name of the scheduled task and of the script. Letters, digits, _ and - only. Default "tidypptsdm_monitor".

script_dir

Folder for the script. Default out_dir.

format

Format of the tables, see write_monitor_tables(). Default "xlsx".

register

Register the task (Windows) or print the crontab line. Default TRUE. With FALSE only the script is written, e.g. to run it by hand with Rscript.

...

Arguments of run_monitor() such as days, house_width, low_feed_kg or station.

verbose

0 (silent) or 1 (summary, default).

Value

Invisibly, the path of the script.

Examples

folder <- file.path(tempdir(), "exports")
dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
data.table::fwrite(tidypptsda::nedap, file.path(folder, "nedap.csv"))
out <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_runs")
script <- schedule_monitor(folder, out, days = 7, register = FALSE)
#> ✔ Monitor script written to /tmp/RtmpBRLQC3/monitor_runs/tidypptsdm_monitor.R
cat(readLines(script), sep = "\n")
#> # Written by tidypptsdm::schedule_monitor() on 2026-10-31 06:38
#> # Daily monitor of the testing stations: edit the settings below if needed.
#> mon <- tidypptsdm::run_monitor("/tmp/RtmpBRLQC3/exports", days = 7)
#> out <- file.path("/tmp/RtmpBRLQC3/monitor_runs", format(mon$settings$end_date))
#> tidypptsdm::write_monitor_report(mon, out)
#> tidypptsdm::write_monitor_tables(mon, out, format = "xlsx")
# run once by hand
source(script)
#> 
#> ── Reading 1 file ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ℹ Detected station type "nedap"
#> ✔ Read 31863 rows from 1 file (NEDAP)
#> 
#> ── Preparing NEDAP visits ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>   Visits read                                31,863
#>   └ unidentified (kept, identified = FALSE)     211    0.7%
#>   └ body weight 0 (set to NA)                   391    1.2%
#> ℹ No pig was seen at more than one station
#> ✔ 30 pigs at 2 stations, 31,863 visits over 97 days 0.2s
#> ℹ No breed column. To use breed in the feed intake model and breed-specific limits, add it with `add_breed()`.
#> 
#> ── Monitoring NEDAP stations: 2024-05-19 to 2024-05-25 (7 days) ────────────────
#> ℹ 2 stations, 28 pigs; on 2024-05-25: 366 visits, 84.8 kg feed
#> ✔ No alerts
#> ✔ Report of 2 stations written to /tmp/RtmpBRLQC3/monitor_runs/2024-05-25/index.html
#> ✔ Wrote /tmp/RtmpBRLQC3/monitor_runs/2024-05-25/monitor.xlsx (16 sheets)
list.files(out, recursive = TRUE)
#>  [1] "2024-05-25/img/station_101_hours.png" 
#>  [2] "2024-05-25/img/station_101_intake.png"
#>  [3] "2024-05-25/img/station_101_trend.png" 
#>  [4] "2024-05-25/img/station_101_weight.png"
#>  [5] "2024-05-25/img/station_102_hours.png" 
#>  [6] "2024-05-25/img/station_102_intake.png"
#>  [7] "2024-05-25/img/station_102_trend.png" 
#>  [8] "2024-05-25/img/station_102_weight.png"
#>  [9] "2024-05-25/index.html"                
#> [10] "2024-05-25/monitor.xlsx"              
#> [11] "tidypptsdm_monitor.R"                 
unlink(c(folder, out), recursive = TRUE)
folder <- file.path(tempdir(), "exports")
dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
data.table::fwrite(tidypptsda::nedap, file.path(folder, "nedap.csv"))
out <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_runs")
script <- schedule_monitor(folder, out, days = 7, register = FALSE)
#> ✔ Monitor script written to /tmp/RtmpBRLQC3/monitor_runs/tidypptsdm_monitor.R
cat(readLines(script), sep = "\n")
#> # Written by tidypptsdm::schedule_monitor() on 2026-10-31 06:38
#> # Daily monitor of the testing stations: edit the settings below if needed.
#> mon <- tidypptsdm::run_monitor("/tmp/RtmpBRLQC3/exports", days = 7)
#> out <- file.path("/tmp/RtmpBRLQC3/monitor_runs", format(mon$settings$end_date))
#> tidypptsdm::write_monitor_report(mon, out)
#> tidypptsdm::write_monitor_tables(mon, out, format = "xlsx")
unlink(c(folder, out), recursive = TRUE)
